answer: A payout is split thus 26% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The crystal schedule is applied in whisper and lantern publishes each instalment. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 536 identities would post 508 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
